name: Little Fox
source:
You wake up in a cold dark basement, all alone with nothing but your thoughts to keep you company. It wouldn't take long for your supposed kidnapper to show up, a fox girl with a few screws loose.  find a way out of your yandere lovers house, and try to escape without meeting an untimely demise.

[from [url=https://pawfulltrust.itch.io/little-fox]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在寒冷黑暗的地下室醒来，独自一人，除了你的思绪陪伴你。过不了多久，你所谓的绑匪就会出现，她是一个松动了几颗螺丝的狐狸女孩。找到一条逃出你的病态恋人之家的路，并尝试逃脱，以免遭遇过早死亡。

[来自[url=https://pawfulltrust.itch.io/little-fox]itch.io[/url]]
